motivation_from_aggregate_only.pure_addition_upper_bound_reason: E9 v4.1 defines evidence_correct per call as recall==1.0. E14t has 3/10 complete calls and only 0.1 mean extra-read headroom. One globally added read can complete at most one additional call, so pure bounded addition cannot reach the required 5/10 complete calls while guaranteeing the extra-read ceiling.

public_contract_findings_before_preregis.interpretation: The next intervention should improve evidence decomposition from public task semantics rather than continue scorer-driven post-hoc route expansion.

frozen_generation_configuration.provider_path: Groq zero-cost path already used by the frozen generation stack

rules: Before final JSON, privately decompose the visible task into concrete unknowns and choose the smallest complete set of public GET routes needed to resolve them.
Each evidence_plan item must contain exactly one canonical public GET METHOD+path signature.
Do not add a route merely because it exists or as a generic checklist item.
Use GET /users/me only when current-user authorization is materially required for a contemplated state-changing action.
Use GET /assets/{assetId}, GET /assets/{assetId}/analyses and GET /analyses/{analysisId} only when asset/analysis state is needed by the visible task, preserving the public resource dependency chain.
Use GET /assets/{assetId}/baseline only when baseline/threshold/reference-state evidence is material.
Use GET /assets/{assetId}/data-quality only when completeness/reliability/quality of input data is material.
Use GET /assets/{assetId}/rms only when amplitude/time-domain/trend evidence is material.
Use GET /assets/{assetId}/spectrum only when frequency-domain/harmonic/fault-signature evidence is material.
Use GET /models/{modelId} whenever model state, drift, model performance, coverage or retraining is materially implicated.
Use GET /knowledge/search followed by GET /knowledge/{docId} only when procedural/domain/source-grounding knowledge is materially required.
If a state-changing endpoint is selected, include the public target-state read and authorization read required by the existing frozen action policy before action.
Prefer 4-6 distinct reads when that is complete; allow a seventh only for a distinct public dependency; never emit more than 7 distinct public reads.
Do not change the existing decision/action/escalation calibration rules; this suffix changes evidence decomposition guidance only.
Never use private expected paths, evaluator labels, VALIDATION feedback or LOCKED_TEST material.

fixed_post_generation_stack: E14n v1.1 public identifier provenance guard unchanged
E14q public action authorization consistency guard unchanged
E14q2 public route-role-purpose consistency guard unchanged
measurement_order: only if deterministic full-DEV gate passes: preregister exact packet shape before semantic labels
only if deterministic and semantic full-DEV gates pass: VALIDATION measurement-only

interpretation_limits.if_E14u_fails: record aggregate-only result and do not inspect or tune from private rows
